summary: Antares Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K announcing a regular distribution, NAV update, and offering status. The distribution is $0.1881 per share, payable September 29, 2026. NAV per share is $24.61 with aggregate NAV of $812.2 million. The company is conducting a continuous offering of up to $2.0 billion in shares, having issued 33,121,053 shares for $829.2 million. This is routine operational reporting for a closed-end fund, not a special situation.
